About

Clarity is the product.

I've shipped 10+ web applications and PWAs for clients, reached Gold Level as a software tester, and evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy and reasoning quality as an AI trainer.

What ties it together is a curious mind that enjoys solving problems and keeps learning, often turning into solutions I didn't plan to build. I use AI to move fast, but never as a shortcut past the parts of the work that actually need care.

Different roles, different clients, same instinct underneath: understand a problem well enough to fix it.

What I Do

What's actually in the toolbox.

From shipping the product to testing it, evaluating the AI behind it, and writing the story that sells it.

01 / 05
01

Full Stack Web Development

End-to-end web development, from databases and backend logic to responsive frontend interfaces, building fast with AI-assisted tools to prototype, test, and ship working products without waiting on a full traditional dev cycle.
02

Software Testing & QA

Manual and exploratory testing, bug identification, usability review, and detailed, actionable reports that catch what breaks before users do. Gold Level tester on testIO.
03

AI Data Evaluation

RLHF evaluation, rubric-based scoring, prompt testing, and reviewing model outputs for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, instruction adherence, and hallucinations.
04

Content Writer & Creator

End-to-end content creation, from research and ideation to polished writing and production, across text, visuals, and video.
05

Visual Storyteller, AI & Canva Design

Professional AI-generated videos from script to final cut, plus AI & Canva visuals: graphics, social posts, brand assets, and campaign creatives that stay on-brand.
  • Script writing tailored for AI tools
  • Advanced prompt engineering for quality visuals
  • Scene direction & consistency control
  • Final editing & polishing in CapCut
